frodo.construction_invariants: q32768, nbar8, exact Frodo640 CDF,128-bit native message, salted transform, full seeds; fixed correctness envelope2^-133
frodo.search_space: All80 natural matrix dimensions n8..640 in steps of8. No joint q/noise/nbar optimization.
frodo.objective: Minimize public-key bytes, ciphertext bytes and matrix coefficient count at each supported planning reference.
frodo.limitations: Two heuristic LWE attack families, Gaussian approximation, a separate message-enumeration ceiling with different operation units; not an optimum under complete security analysis. Published n640 has security margins outside this narrow objective.

module.search_space: The11 registered mathematical profiles; canonical fixed-width coefficient encodings. Bounded n/rank alternatives are displayed, not asserted security-equivalent.
module.objective: Remove wasted binary coefficient bits while preserving every mathematical parameter and native plaintext capacity; no lossy compression.
module.limitations: ceil(log2 q) is minimal per-coefficient fixed-width binary storage, not an information-theoretic minimum for a whole vector. Changing ring degree/rank changes message capacity, structure and matrix expansion; flattened LWE equivalence is not full KEM equivalence.
